transcript:
User: Make it quick, I'm on a job site. Forty-five seconds.
Agent: Got it, I’ll keep this super tight.  

How’d you first come across us — was it a voicemail from Jay, an ad, or something you searched?
User: I saw an ad somewhere. Doesn't matter. What's the bottom line, how does this help me catch missed calls?
Agent: Totally get it. We set up a system so when you can’t grab the phone, it still gets answered right away, books the job or takes the details, and texts you what came in so you’re not losing that customer.  

Mhm, to see if it even makes sense for you—on a busy day, how many calls would you say you miss while you’re on site?
User: Around 25 calls a week. What's the cost and how fast can this be set up?
Agent: Gotcha, 25 a week adds up fast.  

Pricing depends a bit on your setup, but most folks your size land in the low thousands a month, and once we’ve got your script and routing nailed, we can usually have you live in about a week.  

So when those 25 callers don’t get you, are they mostly hanging up, or leaving voicemails you don’t get to until later?
User: Mostly hang up. Low thousands, huh? Can this actually book those 45% back or what?
Agent: Got it, so they’re just disappearing.  

Yes—when it’s set up right, we’re typically recovering 40–60% of those missed calls into booked appointments or solid leads, and you get a text with the details so you can follow up if needed.  

Mind if I sanity-check the cost of those missed calls with your numbers real quick—like 20 seconds?
User: Fine, but make it snappy. I already know each job is $900, so what's the recovery worth?
Agent: Right—at your numbers, that’s about 43 grand a month walking away if you’re missing 25 calls a week and could close 45%.  

So… it’s a 20‑minute walkthrough where we plug in *your* numbers and show exactly how many of those we can realistically recover—what’s better for you this week, later today or tomorrow?
User: Tomorrow morning, 8 AM sharp, Eastern. Make sure it's quick, I've got crews waiting. Number's +13055550003.
Agent: Got it, tomorrow at 8 AM Eastern and we’ll keep it tight so you can get back to your crews.  

Quick thing so we can lock this in—what’s your first name?
User: Boris. Make sure everything's ready. I don't have time for any delays.
Agent: Got it, Boris.  

Quick one—what’s your last name?
User: Petrov. Now, that's it. See you tomorrow. I have machines running, got to go.
Agent: Got it, Boris Petrov. You’re all set for tomorrow at 8 AM Eastern, and we’ll keep it tight so you can get back to your crews. We’ll call you on the number you gave, no delays. Talk tomorrow.
